notes: לָאַחֲרֹנָה: the preposition and the assimilated article are both unrepresented, the adjective alone carrying hindmost. Rule 12 states in terms that the bracketed article is marked unrepresented where the ASV writes no the, and rule 40 leaves a preposition whose relation the ASV states no word for. The rule 30 fusion reading is named in the s017 note.
The two waws of the 57,000 figure are matched to the two ands by the numerals each stands between, across the tens-before-units reordering (rule 42).
